# NYC Taxi — Distance Distribution

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Distribution of trip distances

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    FLOOR(trip_distance) as distance_miles,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(total_amount) as avg_fare
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2019-01-03'
  AND pickup_datetime < '2019-02-02'
  AND trip_distance BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY FLOOR(trip_distance)
ORDER BY distance_miles
```
